description: Source code implementing the strategy for handling PodTemplates in Kubernetes, including creation, validation, update, and warning logic.

classes.name: podTemplateStrategy
classes.description: Implements behavior for PodTemplates, including creation, update, validation, and warning logic.

methods.name: NamespaceScoped
methods.description: Returns true indicating PodTemplates are namespace scoped.

methods.name: PrepareForCreate
methods.description: Initializes fields for a new PodTemplate before creation, setting generation to 1 and dropping disabled fields.

methods.name: WarningsOnCreate
methods.description: Returns warnings related to the creation of a PodTemplate.

methods.name: Canonicalize
methods.description: Normalizes the object after validation (no implementation).

methods.name: AllowCreateOnUpdate
methods.description: Returns false, disallowing creation on update.

methods.name: PrepareForUpdate
methods.description: Prepares a PodTemplate object for update, dropping disabled fields and updating generation if needed.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a PodTemplate, considering feature flags and previous state.

methods.name: WarningsOnUpdate
methods.description: Returns warnings for updates, especially if generation has changed.
